description: Alterations including conversion of the existing residential flat at lower ground floor into five HMO rooms to be used in connection with existing HMO (sui generis) on upper floors, erection of single-storey rear extension at lower ground floor to provide communal kitchen and living room facilities, internal and external refurbishment and reconfiguration/remodelling of existing HMO, including replacement of windows; erection of rear dormer window and replacement of two existing rear dormers; erection of new cycle store & bin enclosure (following removal of existing structures) and increase in height of front boundary wall. (Amendments to listed building consent ref.2024/3632 to include alterations to internal layout)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The work to which this consent relates shall be begun not later than three years from the date of this consent. 
Reason: To comply with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 and the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.
Condition : 2 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following plans and specifications: 2507 P-001, 2507 P-210, 2507 P-211, 2507 P-212 Rev.01, 2507 P-213, 2507 P-214, 2507 P-215, 2507 P-230,  2507 P-240, 2507 P-241, 2507 P-242, 2507 P-250, 2507 P-251, 2507 P-260, 2507 P-270, 2507 SK-250616-001 Rev. 01, WBS.CC.PH01, WBS.CC.PH02, WBS.CC.PH03 Rev. T1, WBS.CC.PH04, WBS.CC.PH05 and WBS.CC.PH06, WBS.CC.MV01, WBS.CC.MV02, WBS.CC.MV03 Rev. T1, WBS.CC.MV04, WBS.CC.MV05 and WBS.CC.MV06.  
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development in accordance with Council policy LP3 of the Local Plan and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.

Condition : 3 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details specified in the submitted Contractor Method Statement.
Reason: To ensure a high quality of development and to accord with policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details specified in Appendix 4 'Surviving Historic Fixture and Fittings' and Appendix 'Historic Doors to be Retained/Relocated' of the submitted Heritage Statement. 
Reason: To ensure a high quality of development and to accord with policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 5 - The works of demolition/alteration hereby authorised shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the drainage and ventilation details shown on the approved plans listed on this decision notice. 
Reason: To ensure a high quality of development and to accord with policies LP1 and LP3 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 6 - REASON FOR GRANTING LISTED BUILDING CONSENT The Council has had regard to local development plan policies, to any representations received and to other material planning considerations. The following policies were considered relevant to the grant of planning permission: - Local Plan (2023) policy LP3 historic environment The proposal has been granted permission for the following reasons: The proposal would not harm the significance of the Grade II listed building or its settings, thereby according with policy LP3 and Section 66 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and the NPPF.
Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE: The applicant undertook a comprehensive photographic study of the exterior and the interior of the building as it currently exists. These are of high significance in the context of the history of the building and the photographs should be deposited in the appropriate Historic Environment Record locally, namely Battersea Local History Library, and with the Historic England HER.
